summary: Access cascade and license rebind for internal secondment with staggered device handover
description:
Issue summary: Internal secondment (Marketing-to-Product, 2026-02-22 -> 2026-05-22) requires a timebound cascade of access changes and transfer of licensed software tied to a company laptop. Request is to clarify policy and get operational approval for an automated handover sequence that: 1) timeboxes OAuth group membership changes via SCIM at start/end dates, 2) triggers license rebind for JetBrains and Tableau to the receiving manager (temporary bridge) and 3) schedules physical device pickup with KMS tag handoff and inventory update.

Background: The employee (internal ID hidden) is moving teams for a 3-month secondment. Historically we've done manual, checklist-driven transfers which require multiple tickets and manual license reassignments. That approach caused two problems last quarter: missed license reclaim (incurring extra seats) and orphaned KMS tags on a returned device that prevented redeployment for 7 days. We want to avoid repeating those failures for predictable secondments.

Request: Confirm whether we can standardize the following automated workflow for timeboxed secondments: a) create a SCIM scheduled rule to add new team groups at start_date and remove them at end_date, b) run a license rebind playbook that transfers per-user entitlements to a bridge account, c) tag device KMS metadata to reflect pending return and create a pickup appointment 3 business days after end_date, and d) emit an audit artifact to Confluence and Slack #it-ops on completion. If automation is not approved, request guidance on minimal manual steps and runbook changes.

Constraints: Some licenses (e.g., Tableau Server seats) require org-admin action and cannot be rebinded via API. KMS tags must remain auditable and we must not break existing device encryption bindings. HR requires audit trail retained for 12 months.

Acceptance criteria: 1) approved workflow or a documented manual fallback; 2) an automation PR or runbook change merged before 2026-02-20; 3) test run in staging demonstrating license rebind and KMS tag update without data loss; 4) update to Confluence runbook and a short how-to for team leads.
investigation_notes: Initial checks: SCIM scheduled rules exist in org-config but are currently only used for terminations. Inventory shows 1 device assigned to the user with serial ending in -B4F. KMS metadata schema includes fields 'owner', 'department', 'return_expected' but not 'secondment_bridge'. JetBrains seats are transferable via API; Tableau requires admin console. Risks: automated removal without license rebind will orphan seats; KMS tag rename is safe but not reversible if we delete the mapping. Referenced logs: infra-scm-sync logs (2026-02-12), device-inventory change history (2026-02-10).
comments: Asha Patel (2026-02-15): Filing on behalf of People Ops. Need guidance on whether we can automate this pattern for recurring secondments. Marking as time-sensitive because secondment starts 2026-02-22.

Leah Morrison (IT Manager, 2026-02-16): From an IT perspective the license rebind is the biggest blocker. I'll coordinate with App Admins for Tableau but want a fail-safe to avoid losing the seat if the admin step is delayed.

Riley Chen (Assignee, 2026-02-17): Investigating SCIM scheduled rules. I opened a draft automation PR to create scheduled group membership events for test accounts. Linking PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/it-automation/pull/144. Planning a short staging test 2026-02-18.
Miguel Santos (Security, 2026-02-18): Please ensure KMS tag changes go through a privileged service account with MFA. Also confirm audit retention meets HR requirement.
resolution_notes: Workaround agreed: For this secondment we will run a hybrid process. 1) Manual admin rebind for Tableau by App Admin (scheduled 2026-02-19), 2) SCIM scheduled rule created for group add/remove (automation PR linked), 3) device pickup scheduled through logistics and KMS tag updated by IT during pickup. Follow-up action: merge automation PR and add 'secondment_bridge' field to KMS metadata template. Owner: Riley Chen. Target close: 2026-02-20.
follow_up_actions: Merge PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/it-automation/pull/144 into main and run staging test
Add 'secondment_bridge' to KMS metadata schema and update Confluence runbook
Coordinate Tableau rebind with App Admin (Leah Morrison) and confirm completion via ticket update
